content.short: BIM Exchange lets users buy, sell, swap, bridge and stake crypto from one DeFi app.
content.description: BIM Exchange brings several DeFi actions into one app: buying crypto with euros by card or bank transfer, selling, swapping, bridging, staking and bonds. Plasma appears among its supported networks, and DefiLlama tracks its BIM Yield product on Plasma.
content.meta: BIM Exchange combines fiat on-ramp, swaps, bridging and staking in one DeFi app, supporting Plasma.
content.pageTitle: BIM Exchange - Web3 Wallet Tools - Lancers Web3 Explorer
